good: Bold Burnout-style HUD with big speed number, position, lap, segmented boost bar and takedown count
Trailer shows a punchy angled TAKEDOWN card, near-miss boost and speeds up to 300 km/h
Coherent sunset city look with grandstands, a start gantry and a cable-stayed bridge
bad: Steering failed the measured check, and after the first crash the car stays pinned against the wall at 0-30 km/h in 8th for the whole free-play section
WRONG WAY shows up again and again: after a crash the car can't get back into the race
City blocks are plain black boxes and the scene is very dark and repetitive close up
opus-5.5-xhigh.one_line: The HUD and takedown card look the part, but one wall hit leaves you stuck grinding the barrier in last place with steering that doesn't work.

good: Strong Burnout-style HUD with big speed readout, position, boost bar and takedown count
Punchy TAKEDOWN card and CRASHED/NEAR MISS popups, sunset city skyline with bridge
Trailer shows 300 km/h speed, boost, rivals and a takedown
bad: In the controls test the car crashes at about 10 s and then sits stuck at near-zero speed against a wall, flagged 'WRONG WAY'. It stays at 8th for the rest of the film.
Steer-left check failed. The steering rows show a car that hardly moves, so left/right can't be confirmed.
Scenery is flat and dark with box buildings. The car is low-poly, and the road is a dull dark asphalt.
sonnet-5.5-xhigh.one_line: It looks and sounds like a Burnout-style game with a great HUD and a punchy takedown, but in the scripted test the car crashes at full speed, gets stuck on a wall and stays last.

good: Bold HUD visibly tracks speed, boost and race position.
Large takedown card and sparks sell impacts.
Walkthrough shows fast bends, rivals and a bridge.
bad: Steering directions fail the control check.
Repeated wall trapping leaves the car barely moving.
Repetitive box towers and flat surfaces make the world sparse.
gpt-6.1-sol-xhigh.one_line: The fast runs and takedown flash look promising, but broken steering and getting stuck against walls spoil the racing.

good: HUD is genuinely Burnout-like: position, lap 1/3, segmented boost bar, tachometer speed, wrecks/takedowns, DRIFT and TAKEDOWN cards
Real track content - start gantry with crowd stands, city canyon, suspension bridge over a cliff - plus 7 distinctly coloured rivals
Drift gives instant slip, tyre smoke and a DRIFT card; boost is clearly faster and camera blur sells the speed
bad: Steering is inverted: A turns the car right and D turns it left (confirmed in source and by live test) - a brief-mandated failure the agent's own test mis-signed
The scripted drive spends most of the film pinned against a barrier at 0-3 km/h with WRONG WAY on screen, so the graded run never shows a clean lap
Cars jam nose-first into walls with gas held and give no escape; the walkthrough MP4 has no audio track despite the sound-heavy brief
minimax-m3.1-flash-free.one_line: The look and HUD are convincing Burnout, but the steering is inverted, so every turn goes the wrong way and the car ends up grinding along the barrier.
